rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Why can Blades make use
of ether like they do?

rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0002
rows.name:
And why is the source of miasma also
ether from Divine Beasts?

rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I can't help thinking the answer lies
in this question, though at first it
seems to take us back to square one.

rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0004
rows.name:
What if Blades and Divine Beasts are
not separate species, but lie on the
same continuum...?

rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0005
rows.name:
No, no, no... Surely that can't be
right, can it?

rows.label: tlk70000063_05_msg0006
rows.name:
I got carried away and leapt too far
in my logic. Yes.
